title: demo.json
description: The keynote cut: title cards and scenes in story order. Read by build-keynote.py, mk-assets.py, keynote-handoff.py, narrate.py and rec.mjs.

title.description: Product name, short. Also names the output file.

logo.description: Logo path relative to demo.json (PNG or SVG). Empty for none.

browser.description: Recording context options for rec.mjs (mk-setup.sh reads DEMO_TIMEZONE and DEMO_LOCALE instead).

windows.description: Named Chrome windows for multi-window recording with rec.mjs and run.mjs.

voice.description: Narration for narrate.py. Every field is optional.

provider.description: say (macOS, free), elevenlabs (needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in the environment, or a macOS Keychain item named by ELEVENLABS_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE or elevenlabs.keychain_service) or files (ready-made voiceover/NN.mp3|wav|m4a: your own recordings, or files made with an MCP voice tool from narrate.py --export-lines). Default: files when voiceover/ has them, else elevenlabs when a key is found, else say.

rate_wpm.description: Words per minute for say and for estimates. Default 165.

say_voice.description: macOS say voice, for example Samantha. Default: system voice.

voice_id.description: ElevenLabs voice id. Default: a stock premade voice.

keychain_service.description: macOS Keychain service name holding the ElevenLabs key, read with `security find-generic-password -s <name> -w` only when ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is unset. The env var ELEVENLABS_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE wins over this. Holds a name, never the key.

lead_in.description: Seconds into an item before its line starts. Default 0.3.

music.description: Music bed path relative to demo.json. Looped, ducked under speech.

music_fade_in.description: Seconds the music fades in at the start. Default 0 (no fade).

music_fade_out.description: Seconds the music fades out at the end. Default 1.5.

match.description: URL part of the tab to drive. Defaults to the first tab.

rx_port.description: Frame receiver port for this window, so two windows can record at once.

trim.description: [in, out] seconds of the raw take; null keeps that end.

zoom.description: [factor, centerX, centerY, startSec, durationSec] in 1920x1080 output coordinates.
